verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no official SDK packages, only a documented REST API with an OpenAPI 3.1 description offered 'for code generators', plus the `cafe api` CLI passthrough. Users would have to generate their own client rather than use a vendor-maintained SDK. Probes of common OpenAPI paths all returned 404, but the docs may host the spec elsewhere, so this lowers confidence rather than contradicting the claim. Missing for 10: official vendor-maintained SDK libraries in any language, SDK documentation and examples, a verified reachable OpenAPI spec location, independent corroboration.
